note: image_policy.py: rules the v2 publisher applies to source images before the chunk exporter hashes them. resample: the 1254 px ground albedos, which no BC format holds, replaced by a recorded, wrap-resampled 1256 px copy (a new v2-only image) that a BC7 sidecar holds at 2 MiB instead of 8 MiB RGBA8. keepUncompressed: images that must keep their own bytes and ship without a rule (no BC sidecar holds a 1254 px image, so the client uploads them RGBA8); check() refuses a resample rule for any of them; retiredDerived names the copy a retired rule used to swap in (its file stays in the pool while a committed package still names it).
